description: Returns how to describe boats for Boatopoly: the fields of one boat with their units, the boat types with their current categories, the allowed values and an example. Call it once before handing boats over.

language.description: The language of the conversation with the seller: German (de), English (en), Spanish (es), Czech (cs), French (fr), Italian (it), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Croatian (hr), Slovenian (sl), Latvian (lv), Swedish (sv), Portuguese (pt), Danish (da), Norwegian (no), Finnish (fi), Greek (el), Turkish (tr) or Hungarian (hu) (default English). The answers and the links to Boatopoly come in this language.
